note: Pinned to the engine release whose assets the app ships. To move it, take the engine tag whose release carries fermix_app_engine_macos_aarch64.tar.gz and fermix_app_engine_macos_x86_64.tar.gz and change, all together: tag (vX.Y.Z), source_commit (the 40-character commit that tag was built from, which the engine-manifest.json inside each tarball repeats), certificate_identity (https://github.com/tezra-io/fermix/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/tags/ plus the tag), each target's asset and each target's sha256 (the digest in the asset's .sha256 sidecar). Either every one of those is null or every one is filled: scripts/engine_pin.sh refuses a half-filled pin, and the release audience of scripts/verify_staged_app.sh refuses a bundle whose staged engine disagrees with what is written here.
